import digitalio
from adafruit_debouncer import Debouncer
import neopixel
import adafruit_rtttl

korobyeyniki = "korobeyniki:d=4,o=5,b=160:e6,8b,8c6,8d6,16e6,16d6,8c6,8b,a,8a,8c6,e6,8d6,8c6,b,8b,8c6,d6,e6,c6,a,2a,8p,d6,8f6,a6,8g6,8f6,e6,8e6,8c6,e6,8d6,8c6,b,8b,8c6,d6,e6,c6,a,a"

pixel = neopixel.NeoPixel(board.NEOPIXEL, 1, brightness=0.2)

CLEAR = (0, 0, 0)
RED   = (255,0,0)
GREEN = (0,255,0)
BLUE  = (0,0,255)

pir = digitalio.DigitalInOut(board.A5)
pir.switch_to_input()
pir_d = Debouncer(pir)
door = digitalio.DigitalInOut(board.D9)
door.switch_to_input(pull=digitalio.Pull.UP)

while True:
    pir_d.update()

    if pir_d.rose and not door.value:
        pixel[0] = BLUE
        adafruit_rtttl.play(board.A3, korobeyniki)
        pixel[0] = CLEAR
